# High-Altitude Oxygenation

**Authors:** Tripthi M. Mathew, Sandeep Sharma

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

High-altitude oxygenation refers to the process of improving oxygen delivery or enriching the body with additional oxygen under conditions of reduced atmospheric pressure at elevated altitudes.
